description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was completed by focusing on the ideal amplifier and basic performance, and by putting all NEC's technologies into it.In addition to five stage independent power supply units, a newly developed reserved power supply unit is installed in the power supply unit.In the case of conventional capacitor input type power supply, since the current is discontinuous pulse flow by repetition of 100 Hz to 120 Hz, there is a time when the current does not flow, and there is a disadvantage that the power supply voltage drops even if a large output is obtained when the capacitor is discharged.To overcome this drawback, a reserve power supply was developed. name: A-10III
description:
## Description

"Based on the A-10TypeII, this pre-main amplifier has a stronger and more rigid structure and improved reserve power supply system.The structure uses a unique mechanical ground construction.In this system, the vibration of each part is completely suppressed by the material and structure, and the vibration of each part with different vibration modes is cancelled by each other in the whole structure by computer simulation. This simplified vibration is dropped on a huge leg and connected to the earth to suppress it.The A-10TypeIII has been further strengthened and refined. It has a structure in which all mechanical vibrations are received by the legs with the occasional reference point of the set itself as the legs of the main body. Sintered alloy legs 50 mm in diameter and 22 mm in height are adopted for the insulators arranged in four places of the bottom plate.In addition, a 3.2 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate in order to securely connect the structural parts and power transformer to the legs.In addition, a cross-beam is used to integrate the left and right side fittings, rear panel, and heat sink. The bottom and cross-beam are connected by four beams, and the core of the power transformer is securely fixed to the beams.In addition, a chimney type heat sink is adopted to prevent fin squeal.With this rigid structure, the main body and the ground are firmly grounded to eliminate the cloudy and cloudy sound caused by the relative relationship between the material and structure of the ground plane and the amplifier.In addition to the normal 4-leg grounding, the insulator can be selected from 2 legs at the rear + 1 leg at the front and 1 leg at the rear + 2 legs at the front.In order to approach the ideal image of the amplifier as ""one wire with amplification degree"", the Simple & Straight concept is adopted, and pure quality is realized by one contact direct connection in which all of attached circuits are jumped as necessary.In order to enjoy the excellent dynamic range and high quality of digital sources such as CDs, it has a direct input to the power amplifier section.In the A-10TypeIII, the quality improvement of the Phono series is re-examined. The EQ amplifier is equipped with DC servo, and the Phono direct position, which connects the Phono amplifier and the power amplifier directly with one contact by using a highly reliable relay, is installed.The REC selector method allows you to record your favorite source regardless of the source being played.In addition, a large vise type screw terminal is adopted to ensure the connection of a very thick speaker cord. This also enables the rear panel supporting the speaker terminal to be made of non-magnetic material. This eliminates magnetic material from the loop of the speaker output current and eliminates electrical disturbance.The AC outlet is equipped with a line filter to prevent noise from entering and jumping.This AC outlet operates unswitched and has polarity indication.Signals recorded in commercially available CD software have both positive and reverse polarity.The A-10TypeIII is equipped with a polarity inversion Pre Out terminal for reverse polarity software in order to manage the polarity of the entire system.Reverse polarity By connecting the Pre Out and Main In with the attached U-shaped pin, the polarity can be reversed at the separate position of operation SW. This enables total polarity alignment.The power supply section uses a large reserved power supply system.In order to maintain a large output even when the capacitor is discharged, another power supply is prepared to compensate for the time when the charging current of the capacitor input type rectifier circuit does not flow. By delaying the phase of the output by 90 ¥, the ripple valley of the main power supply is filled, and it is equivalent to a battery power supply.In addition, the A-10TypeIII has approximately 20% higher current capacity of the power transformer and capacity of the smoothing capacitor, and further lower power impedance, making it an even better power source.A push-pull type amplifier circuit is used for all amplification stages, and superlinearity 2SA-1227 and 2SC-2987 utilizing NEC's semiconductor technology are used for the final amplification stage in parallel push-pull configuration.By using output transistors in parallel, the effective halving of the emitter resistance, which enters the output current circuit in series, is avoided without loss of stability.In addition, the output circuit is designed so that the protection by the ASO limiter is not necessary even with 2 � load. description:
## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier with improved operability for the AV age while applying NEC's original technology such as reserve II power supply.A push-pull type amplifier circuit is adopted for all amplifier stages and a parallel push-pull configuration is adopted for the final amplifier stage. By using output transistors in parallel, the effective halving due to the emitter resistance entering the output current circuit in series can be achieved without loss of stability.In addition, by developing an output circuit that does not require protection by an ASO limiter even under 2 � load, the limiter that impairs linearity of output power is set not to operate.The power supply section is equipped with NEC's original reserve II power supply.This circuit uses another power supply to compensate for the dead time of the capacitor input type rectifier circuit. The phase of the output is delayed by 90 degrees and the ripple valley is filled. This enhances stability.This solves the problem that the power supply voltage drops even if a large output is obtained when the capacitor is discharged, which occurs in the conventional capacitor input type power supply.The AC outlet is equipped with a line filter to cut power supply noise.Mechanical ground construction is adopted as vibration resistant and rigid structural design.By revising the chassis structure to clarify not only the ground potential, which is the electrical reference point, but also the ground point of mechanical vibration, we are reducing the adverse effect of mechanical vibration on the electrical circuit.The A-700 has a structure in which all mechanical vibrations are received by the legs with the occasional reference point of the set itself as the legs of the main body, and the bottom plate is made of sintered alloy of 50 mm diameter and 22 mm height.In addition, in order to securely connect the structural parts and power transformer to the legs, a 2.0 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate. In addition, a cross beam is used to integrally structure the left and right side fittings, rear panel and heat sink. The core of the power transformer is securely fixed to the beam by connecting the bottom plate and cross beam with two beams.As a result, distortion, crosstalk, and deterioration of phase characteristics due to fluctuation of stray capacitance and stray inductance on the signal line are suppressed, and comfortable low sound and sharp high sound are obtained.In the past, the tone circuit was equipped with a bypass circuit such as tone defeat, and it was dealt with by switching the switch. However, even in this case, the signal passes through the switch contact, and the sound quality deteriorates.To cope with this problem, we have developed and adopted a main direct tone circuit that directly controls the characteristics of the main amplifier itself by feeding the signal directly to the main amplifier without passing through the extra amplifier and switch contact.In addition, focusing on group delay characteristics during music playback, especially dispersion of the left and right channels, we have achieved a tone circuit with excellent sense of location by setting optimum values for group delay, phase and amplitude characteristics through computer simulation, controlling impedance and correction curve of both bass and treble volumes, and using audio parts carefully selected for controlling tolerance of circuit constants.A high-gain equalizer amplifier is also available for analog playback.The differential amplifier uses a low-noise Hi GmFET with excellent sound quality, and is equipped with a dedicated shunt-type power supply.Equipped with two input terminals and one output terminal for visual equipment."

description:
## Description
